from hermes_tools import write_file
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u084/system/state/workspace/programs/task-158217f5.py'
print(write_file(p, '''def transform(grid):
    # Translate the lone object to just beyond the full-width divider,
    # and extend the divider's marker color across the next row.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    line=next((r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=1), None)
    if line is None:
        return g
    # identify non-background non-divider object and reposition below divider
    objs=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (1,2)]
    if objs:
        color=grid[objs[0][0]][objs[0][1]]
        # compact bounding box
        rs=[r for r,c in objs]; cs=[c for r,c in objs]
        box=[[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] not in (1,2) else 1 for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
        # erase original object pixels, preserve 1 background
        for r,c in objs: g[r][c]=1
        top=line+1
        for dr,row in enumerate(box):
            for dc,v in enumerate(row):
                if v!=1 and top+dr<h and min(cs)+dc<w: g[top+dr][min(cs)+dc]=v
        if top+len(box)<h: g[top+len(box)]=[8]*w
    return g
'''))
